sourceState: Working tree based on sourceRevision; retained source and emitted hashes identify this audit before its commit

externalThemeDecoder.qualification: deferred until an actual entrypoint exists; internal artifact codec is not an external theme decoder

protocol.scope: Fresh Node process module load/evaluation after harness imports; process startup excluded; scenarios/formats/runtimes sampled in recorded order; OS filesystem caches uncontrolled/warm across repetitions
protocol.memory: heapUsed and RSS deltas after forced GC before/after module load; not peak allocations or exclusively Effect-owned memory
protocol.firstDecode: One small prototype artifact immediately after load/GC; not throughput, warmed latency or theme decoding
protocol.graph: AST-scanned emitted local module graph with direct externals/nonliteral loads; cacheFiles inventory observes CJS cache only, not complete ESM/vendor closure
protocol.environment: macOS Node host measurements, not release Hermes/device measurements or calibrated budgets
